items.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE original game-map harvestable environment sprite. The supplied screenshot is ONLY a visual style, camera and scale reference: match the three solid decorative rock props, trees and foliage on that map. This is NOT an inventory icon. Classic 2D top-down JRPG tileset pixel art, slightly elevated three-quarter view (not diamond isometric), chunky low-resolution pixel clusters, crisp stepped edges, no smooth high resolution illustration, no vector. Design as if at 64x64 game pixels with nearest-neighbor enlargement. Strong readable light/dark planes, upper-left daylight, dark lower-right outline, rich earthy colors compatible with vivid green grass. The object must occupy 90-94% of image width and height with very little empty padding, compact substantial silhouette fully contained, bottom aligned. True transparent RGBA background. No background tile, no grass square, no frame, no UI, no text, no glow, no aura, no vignette, no ground disk, no long cast shadow. A tiny contact shadow attached at base is okay. Must remain very visible as a full-cell prop at 64px on green grass. Subject: A single compact pile of THREE interlocking chunky iron ore rocks, like the gray and brown rocks in the screenshot. Largest boulder behind two smaller boulders, warm slate-gray broad jagged faces with clearly visible rusty reddish-brown iron seams and a few silver-gray ore facets. Broad base, squat solid rock formation nearly square, about one full tile wide and one tile high. Not tiny scattered stones, not crystals, no pickaxe.
